meta.name: Bottle detail ASK v5 — held-out, 300 questions
meta.pass_rule: At least 90% of answers fully correct (grade 2), overall and in each of the three categories.
meta.rubric: 0/1/2 completeness, verbosity <=6 sentence spans and <=1000 characters, scope, tone, factual consistency. Full-credit and weighted whole-answer scores separate from claim precision/recall/F1. Exclude direct Kotlin responses and separately attribute unusable context. No automatic all-pass label based on route.
meta.notes: Held-out set: do not tune the prompt or Kotlin against it. 100 answerable, 100 false claims, 100 unsupported, equal thirds. New question text and new (type, grape) pairs relative to v4. Fresh conversation per case. v4 showed near-identical output across repeat runs, so one run is planned. Profiles and keys are evaluation metadata only, never passed to Gemma. Required facts frozen before the run.
